name: Verusa Holding A.S.
summary: Verusa Holding A.S. is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in recapitalizations, growth capital, restructuring, growth equity, growth stage, and Pre-Initial Public Offering companies. The firm invests in middle market; later stage; mature; turnaround; buyout ; emerging growth; seed/startup; and early, mid and late venture companies. It typically invests in communication services, innovation, software, renewable energy, chemistry, steel construction, information technology, venture capital, health, food, health sector hospitals, chemicals, metals and mining (Bauxite, Gold, Steel).
